sections.title: Architectural Foundations & Specifications
paragraphs: Building portable LLM clients across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Mistral.

questions.prompt: What is the primary architectural goal of Unified Multi-Provider SDK Patterns?
choices: Ensuring provider-neutrality, verifiable evidence, and deterministic execution.
Hardcoding vendor-specific proprietary APIs without fallbacks.
Disabling security boundaries and audit logging.
Ignoring latency, cost, and token limits.
questions.explanation: Unified Multi-Provider SDK Patterns enforces provider-neutral design, auditability, and deterministic operational behavior.
